source.description: The 16/2 recording lists distributed in this repository before split versioning.

paper_split_relationship: Not established. The paper reports 22 selected recordings and an 80/20 data allocation, but its exact recording IDs and allocation unit and procedure have not been recovered.
notes: This is the official public dataset split and benchmark going forward, not a reconstruction of the paper split.
Training and validation are disjoint by complete recording ID.
Subject 18 occurs in both partitions with different recording IDs; subject-disjoint evaluation is not claimed.
